title: The Letter to the Church in Thyatira
description: Jesus praises the church in Thyatira for their love, faith, and perseverance, but accuses them of tolerating the false prophetess Jezebel, who leads believers into sexual immorality and idol worship. He warns that she and her children will be struck with sickness and death, yet promises authority over the nations and the morning star to those who remain faithful until the end.
